sentence: Minh would rather to watch films at home than go out.
ruleVi: Would rather + động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to'.

sentence: My parents would rather I don't go out at night.
ruleVi: Would rather + chủ ngữ khác + quá khứ đơn để nói về hiện tại hoặc tương lai.

sentence: It's time the children go to bed.
ruleVi: It's time + chủ ngữ + quá khứ đơn.

sentence: It's high time you start looking for a job.
ruleVi: It's high time + chủ ngữ + quá khứ đơn: đã đến lúc phải làm.

sentence: My mother would rather I study medicine.
ruleVi: Would rather + chủ ngữ khác + quá khứ đơn.

sentence: I would rather walking than take the bus.
ruleVi: Would rather + V nguyên mẫu + than + V nguyên mẫu.
It's time for + tân ngữ + to + V.

sentence: I'd rather not to talk about it.
ruleVi: Phủ định của would rather: would rather not + V nguyên mẫu.

sentence: It's about time the government does something about traffic.
ruleVi: It's about time + chủ ngữ + quá khứ đơn.

sentence: We would rather you are here on time.
ruleVi: Would rather + chủ ngữ khác + quá khứ đơn; với 'be' dùng were.
